compute_sequence_flow_loss: compute a weighted sequence loss over flow predictions with optional Huber loss and visibility masking
calculate_huber_loss: calculate element-wise Huber loss between two tensors with a configurable delta threshold
compute_sequence_BCE_loss: compute binary cross entropy loss over a sequence of visibility predictions and ground truth
compute_sequence_prob_loss: compute log probability loss for classifying if tracked points are within a pixel threshold of targets
compute_masked_mean: compute the mean of a tensor along specified dimensions using an optional boolean mask
